name: Alex Jamrozek
title: Software Architect | Enterprise Applications
summary: Software architect and engineering leader with 25+ years designing, building, and modernizing enterprise applications. Experienced in distributed systems, API design, SOA, cloud platforms, and software delivery. Hands-on experience in OOP languages, web client UX scripting, and functional DevOps scripting. Combines technical leadership and cross-functional partnership with a focus on secure engineering, automated testing, and production readiness.
